treatments.name: Diode laser hair removal
treatments.short: Reduces hair gradually and for the long term, session by session, on any area of the body.
treatments.hook: Forget razors and wax
treatments.whatIs: The diode laser emits a beam of light that targets the pigment in the hair and weakens the follicle, the root it grows from. Over several sessions, hair grows back less and less, finer and lighter. It's one of the most popular methods for long-term hair reduction.

benefits.title: Long-lasting reduction
benefits.text: Session by session the hair weakens and much less grows back.

benefits.title: Bye-bye bumps and ingrown hairs
benefits.text: Helps reduce the irritation typical of shaving and waxing.

benefits.title: Quick sessions
benefits.text: Small areas take just a few minutes.

benefits.title: Very tolerable
benefits.text: The diode has a built-in cooling head to make the session more comfortable.

benefits.title: Saves money in the long run
benefits.text: Fewer razors, creams and waxing appointments for years.

benefits.title: For everyone
benefits.text: Areas and packs for women and men.

idealFor: Anyone tired of shaving every few days

treatments.sessions: One session every 4 weeks. Usually between 6 and 12 sessions, followed by top-up and maintenance sessions
treatments.results: Many people notice less hair from the first few sessions. The final result depends on hair type, skin and hormonal factors, so it varies from person to person.
aftercare: For the 4 days before and 4 days after each session, avoid direct sunbathing and getting sunburnt. You can carry on completely as normal, just avoid strong direct sun exposure
Use SPF 50 sunscreen on exposed areas
Don't wax or tweeze between sessions; only shave or use cream
Avoid saunas, swimming pools and intense exercise for 24-48 h
Moisturise the area with a soothing cream or aloe vera
contraindications: Pregnancy and breastfeeding

Photosensitising medication (some antibiotics, isotretinoin, etc.)
Wounds, infections or active lesions in the area
Tattoos in the area to be treated
Photosensitive epilepsy or active skin conditions: please check with us first

faq.q: Does it hurt?
faq.a: Most people describe it as a little prick or an elastic band snap with warmth. The handpiece cools the skin and it's quite bearable.

faq.q: Does it work on blonde, red or grey hair?
faq.a: The laser targets dark pigment, so on very light or white hair the results are very limited. We'll be honest with you at the consultation.

faq.q: Is it permanent?
faq.a: We talk about long-lasting reduction: hair is greatly reduced, but hormonal changes can cause some new growth, so you may need the odd top-up.

faq.q: Can I do it in summer?
faq.a: Yes, on areas not exposed to the sun and with sun protection. For exposed areas, we assess each case.

faq.q: Why do I need to shave beforehand?
faq.a: So the light reaches the root and doesn't burn the hair on the surface. Waxing would pull out the root and the laser would have nothing to work on.

faq.q: Does it hurt a lot?
faq.a: It stings at the moment of the pull, especially the first few times. With regular waxing it gets easier and easier.

Pregnancy and breastfeeding
Active acne or infections in the area
Isotretinoin in the last 6 months
Clotting or healing problems

faq.q: Does it work on all scars?
faq.a: Not on keloid or raised scars. It works best on sunken or flat scars. We'll assess it at the consultation.

faq.q: How old does the scar need to be?
faq.a: At least a year old and fully healed.

faq.q: Can it be done on the face?
faq.a: Yes, it's very common for acne scars.

prices.label: Small area (one scar or a small area)
Medium area (e.g. cheeks with acne scarring)

treatments.name: Brazilian micropuncture for hair
treatments.short: Stimulates the scalp to support growth and strengthen hair in areas with less density.
treatments.hook: Give your hair a boost
treatments.whatIs: It's the micropuncture technique applied to the scalp. With controlled micro-perforations in areas with less hair, we stimulate circulation and the follicles, and apply hair actives that penetrate better. The aim is to help strengthen the hair and encourage growth.

benefits.title: Stimulates the follicles
benefits.text: Activates the area so hair grows in better conditions.

benefits.title: Fuller-looking hair
benefits.text: Helps hair look stronger and thicker.

benefits.title: Actives that reach the root
benefits.text: Hair products penetrate much better.

benefits.title: Less hair loss
benefits.text: May help slow hair loss in some cases.

benefits.title: For everyone
benefits.text: Women and men with weakened hair.

idealFor: People with areas of lower density or an early receding hairline
Hair loss due to stress, hormonal changes or the seasons
Fine or weakened hair
Women and men over 18

howItWorks.title: Free initial consultation
howItWorks.text: We assess your scalp and ask about the cause of your hair loss.

howItWorks.title: Cleansing
howItWorks.text: We cleanse and disinfect the scalp.

howItWorks.title: Micropuncture
howItWorks.text: We work on the areas with less density together with hair actives.

howItWorks.title: Guidelines
howItWorks.text: We give you care and washing recommendations.

treatments.sessions: Between 6 and 10 sessions, every 2-4 weeks, followed by maintenance
treatments.results: Hair needs time: changes usually start to show from the 3rd-4th month. Results vary depending on the cause of hair loss and each person.
aftercare: Don't wash your hair for the next 24 h
Avoid dyes, bleaching and harsh products for a week
Avoid direct sun on your head, saunas and swimming pools for a few days
Don't scratch the area
contraindications: Infections, wounds or active dermatitis on the scalp
Pregnancy and breastfeeding
Clotting problems or anticoagulants
Scarring alopecia or hair loss with a medical cause without a specialist's assessment
Allergy to any of the hair actives

faq.q: Does it work for alopecia?
faq.a: It may help with mild to moderate hair loss. If the loss is heavy or sudden, we recommend seeing a dermatologist to find out the cause.

faq.q: Can you tell after the treatment?
faq.a: There may be some redness on the scalp that day, usually hidden by your hair.

faq.q: Is it compatible with other hair treatments?
faq.a: Usually, yes. Tell us what you're using and we'll assess it.
